name: glyphh
description: Glyphh for Claude: your Glyphh account and sign-in, the Ada skill that builds, loads, tunes and asks typed models in Ada Cloud through the Glyphh connector, the glyphh command, Glyphh bots (programs that run a Claude agent behind gates that learn), rrotor (your local runtime for programs and CLIs) installed and connected from Claude, pipelines into rrotor's graph (its semantic layer: your organisation's data as a knowledge graph with search) and apps on it, what Claude made (a page, a dashboard, a doc, a diagram, a deck, a design) published to your organisation's rrotor as an app for review, and the file ledger. Ada is in every plan.
